title: A/E Service for Custer School Remodel
short_description: Architectural and engineering services for remodeling a former school into an aging services facility.
project_scope: Complete remodel of the former Custer Elementary School into a facility for the Morton County Council on Aging and the citizens it serves. The notice indicates a building conversion/refurbishment project but provides no gross floor area, structural dimensions, or technical performance data.
services: Architectural and engineering services including planning, design, contract administration, construction administration, construction inspection, architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, planning/master planning, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building remodel of a former elementary school; no indication of large span, special structure, or architecturally exceptional scope.
- Includes structural engineering among requested disciplines, which gives some relevance.
- Primarily a general building conversion with broad A/E scope rather than a structurally driven or innovative project.
- Administrative and PM-related components are significant, reducing fit with sbp's core profile.
- No evidence of sustainability innovation, lightweight structures, or complex long-span systems.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Useful known information: complete remodel of a former elementary school in Mandan, North Dakota, for use by the Morton County Council on Aging; however, no building area, program size, or renovation extent is provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. Because neither construction cost nor scope quantities are provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for A/E services covering architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, planning/master planning, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
